sources.title: GPT-4o mini: advancing cost-efficient intelligence
sources.evidence: Dated July 18, 2024; explicitly launches mini in the API for text and vision, documents function calling and nominal 128K context. Audio/video support is stated as future work, not a capability of this API model. No parameter count or detailed architecture is disclosed.

sources.title: GPT-4o Mini model documentation
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown fetched directly. Exact alias defaults to gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, with 128,000 context, 16,384 maximum output tokens, text/image inputs, text output, function calling and file uploads. Marks the model deprecated, not shut down.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown fetched directly. PDFs are accepted by vision-capable models and processed into extracted text plus page images. Read with exact mini file-upload and image-input support; PDF denotes an API input format, not a separate native sensory modality.

sources.title: Reasoning best practices
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown read. The guide distinguishes reasoning models from non-reasoning GPT models and explicitly places GPT-4o mini in the GPT execution side of examples, contrasting it with o3-mini planning. This supports the alias classification without claiming an inability to solve reasoning tasks.

sources.title: Prompt Caching in the API
sources.evidence: October 1, 2024 post explicitly lists gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 and states prompt caching applies automatically to mini. This binds the documented caching operation to the exact dated default, not merely to GPT-4o.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown read. The archived guide applies to models before GPT-5.6 and describes OpenAI prompt caching through Transformer layers, attention key/value projections and stored tensors across layers and heads. Combined with exact-mini caching support, this is operational evidence for broad Transformer attention, not a full architecture specification.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown fetched directly. October 14, 2026 notice schedules gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 for January 14, 2027 shutdown. This is a future retirement at the review date; no endpoint call was made.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current terms effective January 1, 2026 grant limited API service access and reserve service intellectual property. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification, not a downloadable-weight license or a claim these exact terms applied in July 2024.

sources.title: Introducing gpt-oss
sources.evidence: Full indexed primary article read after a direct fetch timed out. August 5, 2025 announcement identifies gpt-oss as the first open-weight language models since GPT-2, corroborating that the intervening mini release was closed weights. Its counts and expert routing belong to gpt-oss, not mini.

sources.title: OpenAI o1 System Card
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and text-extracted. Mini-specific comparison columns cover hallucination, bias and multilingual evaluations. All parameter, architecture and Transformer matches were checked; no production count or routing structure for GPT-4o mini is disclosed.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and text-extracted. The model-progression table explicitly identifies GPT-4o-mini as the predecessor of gpt-5-main-mini. No mini parameter count or architecture disclosure was found; GPT-5 characteristics are not transferred.

sources.title: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions
sources.evidence: Training research linked by the mini launch was checked as an architecture lead. This April 2024 research page explicitly applies its method to GPT-3.5; it does not disclose mini structure or size. The mini launch confirms later adoption of the technique without implying shared architecture.

name.note: Exact text/vision API model, distinct from mini audio, realtime, transcription and search variants.

developer.note: Official announcement and model documentation identify OpenAI.

family.note: Use the named GPT-4o family instead of the cross-generation gpt-mini bucket.

release_date.note: Explicit API launch date, corroborated by the default snapshot. Later fine-tuning access and retirement are separate events.

open_weights.note: Hosted API release with no distributed model weights, corroborated by OpenAI open-weight release history. Fine-tuning access does not imply downloadable weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model under commercial service terms, not an SPDX checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: No exact total production count found in launch, model specifications, later model-card comparison tables or linked training research. The mini label and price do not quantify size.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active parameter count is disclosed for this exact mini model. Do not equate active and total counts or infer routing.

architecture.note: Broad classification inferred from the documented Transformer attention caching mechanism and its explicit application to gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18. This operational cross-source evidence does not establish the complete block inventory, exclusively Transformer layers, dense versus MoE routing, dimensions or parameter counts.

context_window.note: Exact official model context is 128,000 tokens. The separate 16,384-token output cap is not the context window; do not substitute 131,072.

modalities.note: Native text/image input and text output are explicit. Retain PDF under the catalog API-file convention: it is processed into text and page images. Planned audio/video and separate tool-generated images are not native outputs here.

reasoning.note: The official reasoning guide places this mini alias in its non-reasoning GPT category. This denotes absence of a dedicated internal reasoning mode, not an inability to reason or produce prompted explanations.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly documented at launch and in exact-mini specifications.

description.value: GPT-4o variant with text and image input, text output, a 128,000-token context window and function calling.
description.note: Replace cheap/production-scale promotional framing with directly documented model capabilities.

patch.description: GPT-4o variant with text and image input, text output, a 128,000-token context window and function calling.

sources.label: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions

patch.notes: The gpt-4o-mini alias defaults to gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, released in the API on July 18, 2024. PDF input is processed into text and page images. Broad Transformer attention is inferred from the documented prompt-caching mechanism and exact-snapshot support; complete block structure, dense/MoE routing and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed. This text/vision model is separate from later audio and realtime variants. OpenAI deprecated the API model on October 14, 2026 and schedules shutdown for January 14, 2027; no live endpoint request was made.

summary: Reviewed all 14 fields. Correct family and proprietary classification, replace promotional copy, and record broad Transformer attention with explicit operational-evidence scope. Confirm July release, precise context, text/image/PDF inputs, text output, function calling and non-reasoning classification. Counts and routing remain undisclosed after later model-card and training research checks; API retirement is scheduled for January 2027.
